Heat in Hanoi

Hanoi

A fast-growing capital whose power and water strain together in the heat.

What heat does here

US$1.4 bn

estimated cost of blackouts in northern Viet Nam in May and June 2023, as heat raised demand and reservoirs ran low.

What is in place

Acting before the peak

From 2018 to 2021, the Viet Nam Red Cross ran early action for heatwaves in 15 Hanoi wards, triggered by a heat-index forecast.

What helps

Plan cooling, power and water together.
